rollups.text: Darryll’s AI-assisted hiring moved from consideration to a lasting hybrid process. On 2024-03-15 he favored a small pilot targeting at least 50% less resume-screening time while tracking diversity and talent quality (T12, T14, T18). Between 2024-04-10 and 2024-04-25, he completed two HireVue-assisted screenings and reported 45% less screening time (T94). On 2024-05-02 he chose to extend the pilot for three more hires (T110, T112); after an age-bias issue surfaced and an audit began on 2024-04-30, he agreed to pause automated decisions and use manual review while the audit proceeded, then also said he would continue the pilot under close monitoring (T170, T172). On 2024-07-18 he committed to a monitored pilot and candidate feedback channels (T188, T190). By 2024-10-03 he endorsed AI for initial screening with human-led final interviews, reporting 35% less hiring time and 18% higher candidate satisfaction since the pilot began (T318, T320, T322). On 2025-01-10 he decided to adopt this hybrid approach permanently; on 2025-01-12 he reaffirmed that humans should interview candidates and assess soft skills and rapport (T332, T348). Elapsed time from initial pilot decision to permanent adoption: about 10 months.

Darryl’s hiring-AI privacy and security work developed from safeguards planning to enforced retention controls. On 2024-04-20 Montserrat Media Hub implemented two-factor authentication; on 2024-05-02 Darryl worried it might not be sufficient and prioritized encryption and an incident-response plan, assigning Jessica to lead with IT support and a 2024-05-31 target (T136, T138, T140, T142). He agreed to a security kickoff meeting for 2024-05-07, though the record does not confirm it occurred (T144, T146, T147). A privacy breach attempt occurred on 2024-09-25 and was later reported as addressed without data loss (T268, T334). Darryl considered a six-month retention limit beginning 2024-10-01 (T290, T294), and said strict automatic deletion after six months was enforced starting 2025-01-08 (T366). Elapsed time from the first reported 2FA implementation to enforced deletion: about 8 months and 19 days.

Darryl’s plans for Michael’s HR-technology career evolved from a possible transfer to a promotion. On 2024-05-02 Darryl planned a meeting about Michael possibly moving from editing to HR tech support; the proposed handover, training, onboarding, and monitored trial were suggestions, not confirmed actions (T160, T162, T163, T165). Michael began mentoring in AI ethics and data analysis on 2024-07-03, and Darryl was checking his progress on 2024-07-18 (T218). Darryl said Michael’s promotion to HR Tech Coordinator, with a 10% raise to $48,000, would take effect 2024-08-01 (T246). Michael led AI ethics training for 15 HR staff on 2024-10-02, with knowledge scores improving 22% (T296). Michael was promoted to HR Tech Manager at $55,000 per year on 2025-01-10; on 2025-01-12 Darryl considered a further promotion (T356). Elapsed time from the proposed transfer discussion to HR Tech Manager promotion: about 8 months.

Darryl’s AI fairness work included vendor customization, measurement, and policy commitments. He began customizing a Pymetrics hiring algorithm on 2024-07-01 with a stated goal of reducing age bias by 15% (T184). On 2024-07-18 he was considering fairness metrics, including demographic parity and equal opportunity, and continued monitoring and audits (T193, T195). On 2024-10-03 he said vendor customization to reduce age bias was underway (T270). By 2025-01-12 he reported algorithmic bias had fallen 30% since July 2024 and that 2024 hires were 50% female and 25% minority (T340, T342). Elapsed time from customization start to reported reduction: about 6 months.

Darryl’s outreach on ethical AI hiring grew from a public panel to further planned knowledge-sharing. On 2024-10-01 Darryl and Carla co-hosted an AI ethics panel at the Montserrat Business Council, attended by more than 50 professionals; community outreach launched on 2024-10-02 (T272, T274). On 2025-01-12 Darryl said a newsletter article about AI hiring had reached over 500 readers, and an ethical AI hiring workshop planned with Carla for 2025-02-20 had over 70 registrants (T344, T354, T386). The workshop was upcoming in the January record; its actual completion is not established.
rollups.topic: Ethical AI hiring outreach and events

rollups.text: Reported hiring-process outcomes changed over time: AI-assisted screening reduced screening time by 45% across two screenings completed between 2024-04-10 and 2024-04-25 (T94); automated interview scheduling reduced coordination time from 10 hours to 3 hours per hire by 2024-05-02 (T114); the average hiring cycle fell from 28 days to 18 days by 2024-07-15, then to 16 days by 2025-01-10 (T252, T370). Darryl reported 35% less hiring time and 18% higher candidate satisfaction by 2024-10-03 (T320). The records do not establish that these figures all use the same baseline or measure.
rollups.topic: Hiring efficiency and candidate satisfaction metrics

rollups.text: Reported hiring-AI financial outcomes and budgets: the initial pilot cost $6,500 and saved about $4,000 in recruiter hours over six weeks as reported 2024-05-02 (T104); by 2024-07-18 the company reported $9,000 in recruitment-cost savings over four months, 18% above initial projections (T198); by 2025-01-10 it reported $22,000 saved through AI use in 2024 (T332, T370). Separately, the approved Q3 2024 AI-upgrade and training allocation was $8,000 (T154), and Darryl approved a $10,000 Q4 budget for upgrades and staff wellness on 2024-10-03 (T308). These amounts refer to different periods and purposes and should not be added as a single net saving.

Candidate-feedback survey response figures reported by Darryl were 85% for post-interview surveys on 2024-10-03 (T324) and 90% cited in a separate question that day about reminder emails (T330). The records do not clarify whether the latter was a later rate, a different survey group, or a hypothetical figure, so the two rates should not be treated as a confirmed increase.

AI hiring and related technologies considered, used, or discussed by Darryl: HireVue was used for two candidate screenings in April 2024 (T94) and was under a two-year, $11,500-per-year contract finalized 2024-07-10 (T186); Pymetrics was considered by 2024-03-15, was suggested for a soft-skills pilot in May 2024, and was used for algorithm customization beginning 2024-07-01 (T38, T106, T108, T184); Oracle Taleo, Unitive, Blendoor, Applied, and Pymetrics were named as tools with fairness or transparency features on 2024-03-15 (T9); an AI calendar integrated with Outlook was associated with an 80% reduction in scheduling conflicts reported 2024-09-20 (T288). These are not all confirmed as concurrently deployed tools.
